authorization.continuation_rule: authorized independent of original resource gate; never mark original gate passed

claim_boundary.primary: representation advantage under fractional delay-Doppler propagation and restricted effective-channel interactions

decision_rules.representation_reproduces: at least four of five selected tail checkpoints have lower joint_0.5 16QAM BER than the strongest operational classical baseline at K=24 and 18 dB, with negative median seed difference; report every seed and channel intervals separately
decision_rules.tail_contributes: at least four of five tail continuations satisfy the mean gate and improve validation CVaR_0.95 over their matched mean continuation; BER effects are reported and may be mixed
decision_rules.computational_saving: validation-selected configuration confirms target on fresh test data with lower declared cost than each compared classical alternative under the same accounting level
decision_rules.runtime_crossover: measured sparse receiver-processing latency is lower than the equivalent dense/precomputed comparator with numerical validity at a measured dimension/budget

training.optimizer_state_policy: selected parent waveform cloned; fresh Adam state in both arms
training.tail_selection: minimum validation stream CVaR_0.95 subject to mean <= 1.02 times selected parent mean

evaluation.primary_grid: all selected parent/mean/tail checkpoints at K=24 across SNR and at 18 dB across K/conditions
evaluation.fixed_step_grid: paired parent/mean/tail endpoints at K=24, 18 dB, joint_0.5 and nominal_dd_v1
evaluation.adaptation: condition, dimension, modulation, SNR, K, receiver and support policy known; never realized-test-channel adaptive

matched_quality.confirmation: fresh locked channels/bits/noise; failure retained; no test reselection

scaling.channel_law: Pub-1B normalized scaling: delay_max=4N/64, doppler_max=.75N/64, P=3
